Source: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D208496
Access: readable in browser on2026-10-06T19:10:50.939Z.

Browser timeline and inline requests inspected. Reviewer requested regression tests although manual test worked; author added a cross-tab test. Coverage expanded to nsMsgSearchDBView for cross-folder cards. C++ reviewer queried whether count1 should be negative; author clarified changed notifications use positive counts because row-deletion notifications already happen elsewhere. Unexpected invalid root changed to NS_WARNING/NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED. Accepted by babolivier, BenC and darktrojan. Original test used a500ms sleep; current accepted test uses condition and animation-frame waits, so the old sleep is not proposed as preferred practice.

Exact source excerpts:
> Yes, all the nsMsgViewNotificationCode::changed notifications need positive numbers. Notifications about the deleted rows are already in place elsewhere.

> I think NS_WARNING() is probably more appropriate in C++ code?
